prompt.project_info: Create a portrait-oriented UGC selfie of an approved adult woman on a balcony at night.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long light-brown wavy hair and bangs, wearing a maroon off-shoulder knit top, layered black ruffle skirt, gold clover jewelry, and red-to-sky-blue glitter gradient nails.
prompt.composition_elements: She faces the camera and touches her bangs with her right hand, framed from mid-thigh upward. Include balcony rail, dark starry sky, jewelry, manicure, and natural hair movement.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright direct camera flash, cool night color temperature, high-contrast shadows, raw sharp nighttime photography.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic portrait photography, natural skin texture, sharp focus, portrait orientation, 4:5 ratio, 35mm lens, direct-flash exposure.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with long light-brown wavy hair and bangs poses on a home balcony at night, touching her bangs while wearing a maroon knit top, black layered ruffle skirt, gold clover jewelry, and colorful glitter manicure. Use direct camera flash, cool high-contrast night light, a dark starry sky, and a natural candid expression. No public figure likeness or invented watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, lingerie, transparent clothing, exaggerated cleavage, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, plastic skin, blurred face, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
